overview.text: Development Partnership Administration-II, Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India, invites two-cover online bids from eligible institutes to design and deliver short-term Basic IT training for foreign participants under the ITEC programme. RFP No. DPA-II/551/05/2016/BasicIT, dated 20.12.2018. Selection is for three years, extendable by one year at each instance by mutual agreement.

summary.issuing_organization: Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India; Development Partnership Administration-II; RFP No. DPA-II/551/05/2016/BasicIT; Section Officer (ITEC-I), Room No. 2079, 'B' Wing, Jawaharlal Nehru Bhawan, New Delhi-110011, Tel: 011-49018130

scope.text: Design and deliver short-term Basic IT training programmes for foreign participants under ITEC; course duration from one week to up to 12 weeks, typically 30 participants per course.
Intended allotment: up to 1200 man-weeks of Basic IT training per institute per year; actual participants attending may vary.
Each programme must be customised in consultation with MEA; MEA may modify training areas, number of programmes and number of participants.
Receive selected participants at the airport, provide lodging and boarding during training, impart training, arrange study tour (if part of the programme) and see participants off at the airport.
Provide emergency support including medical, and ensure continental food at subsidized rates; food payment is settled between participant and institute.
Disburse the participants' living allowance on behalf of MEA on a weekly or fortnightly basis, with the first instalment on the day of arrival.
Arrange single-occupancy hostel or hotel accommodation with air conditioning, attached toilets, TV, bedding and toiletries, in-room tea/coffee maker, locker, security and recreational facilities.
Submit reports on the ITEC online portal as well as offline.

key_requirements.text: Bids must be submitted online only on the Central Public Procurement Portal; manual bids will not be accepted under any circumstances.
Originals of bid security and RfP processing fee must reach Section Officer (ITEC) before the bid submission end time; bids without them will be rejected straight away.
Technical and financial bids must be digitally signed on the portal; bidder must hold a valid digital signature certificate at own cost.

Technical proposal must include: processing fee instrument, bid security instrument and bank details, power of attorney or authorisation certificate, filled technical proposal with numbered pages, Sheets 1 to 3 in .xls format, and proposed training courses (details of up to four programmes).
Conditional bids will be summarily rejected; bid must not contain inapplicable terms and conditions.
Price schedule must be submitted online only in the prescribed BOQ BasicIT.xls, in figures and in words; a modified BoQ file leads to bid rejection.
Bidder must accept any change in scope of supply without change in the quoted unit price.
Accommodation must be single occupancy with the listed facilities; bidder must quote accommodation type and per-night cost, and the accommodation is examined during the MEA team visit.
Institutes should organise at least one inaugural or valedictory function per course with an MEA representative present (desirable wording: should).
Wrong or misleading information, found during the MEA campus visit, leads to disqualification and penal action including forfeiture of EMD.

eligibility.text: Bidder must have been shortlisted in MEA's Expression of Interest, EOI No. DPA-II/551/05/2016 dated 29 May 2018, and specifically invited to participate in the RfP.
MEA may reject a proposal at any stage and declare the institute ineligible or blacklist it, indefinitely or for a stated period, for corrupt or fraudulent practices.

important_dates.text: Date of publishing, RfP download/sale start and online queries start: 20.12.2018 (1000 Hrs).
Online queries end date: 01.01.2019 (1500 Hrs); queries only on the CPP Portal.
Bidders wishing to attend the pre-proposal meeting must send contact details to MEA by 1500 hrs on 01.01.2019.
Pre-proposal meeting: 02.01.2019 (1100 Hrs), Room No. 2079, 'B' Wing, Jawaharlal Nehru Bhawan, New Delhi.
Opening of financial bids: date and time to be informed later, only for bidders scoring 50% or more in the Preliminary Technical Score.
Bid validity: minimum 180 days from the date of opening of proposal; a bid valid for a shorter period stands rejected.

commercial_requirements.text: Bid security (EMD) Rs. 2,00,000/- (Rupees Two Lakh only), valid 225 days from bid opening (45 days beyond offer validity); clause 9.1 allows Bank Guarantee only, but clause 11.5 also allows Demand Draft / Pay Order.
RfP processing fee Rs.2000/-, non-refundable, by DD/Pay Order favouring Pay and Accounts Officer, Ministry of External Affairs, New Delhi.
Bid security is forfeited if a bidder withdraws after opening of technical bids, or if the selected bidder fails to furnish the Performance Bank Guarantee in due time; no interest is payable.
Performance Bank Guarantee of Rs Thirty Six Lakh within 30 working days of Supply Order, valid till six months after the end of each financial year and extended annually.
Payment: 50% of total approved estimated cost at the start of each course on submission of Joining Reports; balance within 3 months of course completion with final bill and original vouchers.
Prices must be quoted in INR in BOQ.xls only, firm with no price escalation, exclusive of taxes; hotel accommodation charges must be quoted inclusive of applicable taxes.

Bidders quote only course fee (per participant per week) and accommodation (per night); other components are fixed or reimbursed at actuals, e.g. living allowance currently Rs. 1200/- per day and book allowance up to Rs 5000 per participant per course.
Liquidated damages / penalty rates and warranty period: Not specified in the document (PBG clause mentions warranty obligations 'if any'; force majeure clause mentions penalty without a rate).

project_duration.text: Selection is for three years, extendable by one year at each instance upon mutual agreement.
A separate supply order is issued for each financial year.
Course duration ranges from one week to up to 12 weeks.

important_conditions.text: Evaluation: Preliminary Technical Score (PtS) out of 100 on NIRF ranking (20 marks), profile and track record (25), institute infrastructure (30) and human resource (25).
Evaluation: Only bidders scoring 50 or more in PtS go forward; MEA visits their campus and gives a Visit Score (VS) out of 100; TS = ( 0.7 x PtS ) + ( 0.3 x VS ).
Evaluation: QCBS with technical score weighted 70% and financial score 30%; FS = (70 * TS / TShigh) + (30 * CL//C); bids ranked by descending Final Score.
Evaluation: Quoted price C is on a per participant per week basis, taken as course fee rate plus accommodation rate x 7.
Evaluation: Financial bids are opened only for bidders scoring 50% or more in PtS, in presence of bidders' representatives who choose to attend.
Submission: Two covers online on the CPP Portal: Envelope No. 1 Technical Proposal and Envelope No.2 Financial Proposal, submitted concurrently.

Submission: Originals of EMD and processing fee must be put in a sealed envelope superscribed as specified and delivered to Section Officer (ITEC), Room No.2079, Jawaharlal Nehru Bhawan, New Delhi, on or before bid submission date/time.
Submission: Technical parameters, training experience and human resource details must be uploaded strictly in Sheet 1, Sheet 2 and Sheet 3 of TechnicalDetails_BasicIT.xls.
Risk: Bid security form conflicts: clause 9.1 (Bank Guarantee only) versus clause 11.5 (Bank Guarantee or Demand Draft / Pay Order).
Risk: A bid uploaded online but without the physical originals of bid security and processing fee is rejected straight away.
Risk: Scoring table is inconsistent: NIRF ranking has max marks 20 but its value-marks go up to 30.
Risk: No guaranteed volume: allotment is only up to 1200 man-weeks per year and MEA may modify training areas, programmes and participant numbers.
Risk: Prices are firm with no escalation over a three-year term, and scope changes must be accepted without change in unit price.
Risk: Performance Bank Guarantee of Rs Thirty Six Lakh due within 30 working days of Supply Order, and must be renewed annually.
